youtube.title: Lesotho Tops the List — The Loneliest Countries in the World
youtube.description:
In Lesotho, 58% of people say they feel very or fairly lonely — the highest rate measured on Earth. Across the world, nearly 1 in 4 people feel lonely. Where does your country rank?

This is a look at the loneliest countries, by the share of people who say they feel very or fairly lonely, from the Meta-Gallup State of Social Connections global survey (data collected 2022-2023, 142 countries).

A note on the data: Gallup published these as an interactive global map rather than a full ranked table, so this video features the countries with clearly reported figures. Globally, 24% of people feel lonely, and the highest rates are concentrated in Africa and South Asia.

Do you feel it too? Let us know in the comments.
